issue.title: Bug: lldp/lldp_test_syncd failure due to wait_until_lldp_populated not waiting for all interfaces

failure.body:
### Is it platform specific

generic

### Importance or Severity

Medium

### Description of the bug

wait_until_lldp_populated function does not wait for all interfaces to come up, instead it waits for cli and DB to match. This can result in an early return before all interfaces come up, causing the test to fail without waiting for enough time. It should instead check if cli, db, and expected interfaces all match.

Using pdb I confirmed the cli and db do match shortly after assertion failure.

### Steps to Reproduce

Run
`lldp/test_lldp_syncd.py::test_lldp_entry_table_after_syncd_orchagent`
Intermittently will fail due to early return of `wait_until_lldp_populated`

Confirm using PDB or on DUT that the db and cli agree on lldp entries, but do not actually have the missing entries given by the failure

### Actual Behavior and Expected Behavior

Expect passed, get failed
